## What this system is

The system document has not been written yet, so there is no architectural overview to
open. Run `/docs` to create the initial documentation.

## Components

| Component | Owns | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Cache](../backend/src/cache/DOCS/Cache.md) | `backend/src/cache` | The cache unit owns the application's shared cache. It exposes a single NestJS module, CacheModule, that registers a global cache with a five-minute default TTL and a one-thousand-item limit. <sup>[1](../backend/src/cache/DOCS/Cache.evidence.md#research.backend-src-cache.7f2e5345)</sup> Any module that imports CacheModule can use the cache, and the root AppModule already does, making the cache available across the application. <sup>[2](../backend/src/cache/DOCS/Cache.evidence.md#research.backend-src-cache.3854dd3f)</sup> <sup>[3](../backend/src/cache/DOCS/Cache.evidence.md#research.backend-src-cache.c6629710)</sup> |
| [Config](../backend/src/config/DOCS/Config.md) | `backend/src/config` | The config unit owns the application's configuration. It exposes a single NestJS module, AppConfigModule, that registers the @nestjs/config ConfigModule as a global module, loading a configuration factory that reads environment variables with fallback defaults and exporting ConfigModule for any importing module. <sup>[1](../backend/src/config/DOCS/Config.evidence.md#research.backend-src-config.f3479eba)</sup> The root AppModule imports AppConfigModule, making the configuration available across the application. <sup>[2](../backend/src/config/DOCS/Config.evidence.md#research.backend-src-config.0b0b5327)</sup> |
| [Terms](../frontend/src/app/terms/DOCS/Terms.md) | `frontend/src/app/terms` | The terms unit owns the Terms of Service page for the Tuks Schedule Generator service. It renders a static, presentational page that states the service's terms: what the tool does, user responsibilities, Google Calendar access, data processing and privacy, accuracy and verification, liability limits, and the remaining legal provisions. The page takes no props, holds no state, and performs no data fetching. <sup>[1](../frontend/src/app/terms/DOCS/Terms.evidence.md#research.frontend-src-app-terms.118f95e7)</sup> <sup>[2](../frontend/src/app/terms/DOCS/Terms.evidence.md#research.frontend-src-app-terms.709797fa)</sup> |
